A slice of Bali, right here in Noida.

Yuvan Cafe & Restro is a Bali-themed cafe in Sector 121, Noida — plant-filled corners, warm light, and a menu that travels from North Indian classics to Italian, Japanese and Thai favourites.

Book a Table Explore services
About Us

Slow down, eat well, stay a while

Step inside and the city feels far away — thatched ceilings, hanging lights, green plants everywhere and space to breathe. It is the kind of place made for long lunches, family dinners and quiet coffee dates.

The kitchen covers a lot of ground: North Indian comfort food, wood-fired pizza, handmade dimsums, sushi, pasta and a proper coffee and matcha bar.

LocationPK-47, Sector 121, Noida
Hours12:00 PM – 11:00 PM, every day
